programme.title: Andromeda: Tid uden for sindet
programme.desc: Abyss dræber Beckas ven, og besætningen må finde ud af, hvilke oplysninger de dræbte for at få fat i.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonante interval (del 1)
programme.desc: Andromeda redder et skib, der vender tilbage fra fredsforhandlinger med Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonante interval (del 2)
programme.desc: Magog-angrebet har alvorlige konsekvenser. Andromeda bliver ødelagt, Trance og Dylan formodes at være de eneste overlevende, og Dylan flygter ud i tidernes rute

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 1)
programme.desc: Dylan ender på Seefra, hvor den overtroiske befolkning ikke har nogen teknologi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka bliver dumpet på Seefra, efter at Andromeda er blevet stjålet, og Dylan skal bevise, at skibet er hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: På Seefra finder Dylan dog Harper, som har tilpasset sig til livet der.

programme.title: Andromeda: Englens forfald
programme.desc: Det viser sig, at Doyle er en android, som Harper har bygget til at indeholde Rommies kerneprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologien i vores nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinder en pris fra en radio-DJ, lærer sandheden om Seefra og finder Meethus-diagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Når det går rundt...
programme.desc: En videnskabsmand fra det oprindelige Commonwealth dukker op og er fanget i en tidsløjfe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Forsøg på afretningslag
programme.desc: Flavin vender tilbage, hvilket udløser en bandekrig, og hjælper Dylan med at udvikle sig som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så brænder de utæmmede lande
programme.desc: En krystal, der kan genoprette Andromedas kraft, bliver fundet, men for at få fat i den må Dylan arbejde for minens ejer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke
programme.desc: Der er opdaget tunneller på Seefra, som kan bruges til at nå otte andre Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke

programme.title: Andromeda: Prøven
programme.desc: Da en gammel mand bliver dræbt, er Beka, Rhade og Harper de hovedmistænkte og skal for retten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Gennem et mørkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder oprørerne i en kamp mod en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthed før faldet
programme.desc: Dylan finder ud af, at Bekas kæreste var Drago Musevini, og at han brugte Bekas DNA til at skabe nietzscheanerne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Måneskin bliver til dig
programme.desc: Beka og Rhade finder en prøve, der enten vil give dem stor rigdom eller drive dem til vanvid.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er uendelig
programme.desc: Harper opdager et program, der kan ødelægge otte af Seefra-planeterne og dræbe millioner af mennesker.

programme.title: Andromeda: Modsætningerne af tiltrækning
programme.desc: Mens Harper arbejder på en måde at redde Seefra-systemet på, sniger en spion sig om bord på Andromeda og angriber Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin slider med at komme videre efter Brody. Audrina møder Justin og begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Ryan. Lo bliver venner med Brodys nye kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme lægger sig ud med Kristin da hun tager en af Kristins rivalr med til en fest. Ryan kommer tilbage fra turneen, men Audrina forteæler ham ikke, at hun mødtes med Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan bliver sat på prøve, da han møder Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side da Allie skændes med hende. Stephanie har en skuffende anden date.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Lige da Audrina afslutter tingene med Ryan, overrasker Justin hende på hendes fødselsdag. McKaelas ven Allie skaber flere problemer for Kristin. Brody fortæller Justin hvad han tænker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gruppen tager til Vegas for at se Brody optræde som dj, og Justin føler sig fanget mellem Audrina og Stephanie. Der udbryder naturbrande i Malibu og Kaitlyn frygter for Brodys liv, da han bliver i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn skal forholde sig til naturbranden i Malibu. Audrina træffer en svær beslutning om Justin. Mischa skal til audition til en stor filmrolle og Heidi vil genoplive sin popsangerinde-karriere.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Rygterne flyver efter en skadaløs hændelse, der involverer Brody og Stephanie. Audrina får et chok, da Justin tager en flot date med til middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brodys 'A-liste-galla skaber splid i gruppen, da hun ekskluderer visse medlemmer. Audrina overrasker alle ved at genantænde et forhold til en gammel flamme. Spencer chokerer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynns ægteskab er i uføre da rygterne svirrer om deres kærlighedsliv. Efter at have lovet eksklusivitet begynder Brandon at tvivle på sit forhold. Audrina lægger sin skilsmisse bag sig og indleder en ny forretningssatsning.
programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterer Brody med hans ægteskabsstatus og sandheden afsløres. Brandon træffer en endelig beslutning om sit forhold til Ashley. Whitney deler en følelsesladet nyhed med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Da Lauren fortæller Heidi, hvad hun virkelig mener om Spencer, må Heidi vælge mellem sin bedste veninde og sin kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren indser, at hun ikke kan stole på sine bedste venner, efter Heidi fører Jen og Brody sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer beder Heidi flytte ind med ham, men Heidi ved ikke, hvad hun skal gøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortælle det til sin bofælle Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bad Bromance

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Hemmelighedshullet slår til, da Angela bliver sat i den varme stol, og Nurys skal træffe en vigtig beslutning. Ekserne mødes med en overraskende eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter i anden del af Ex on the Beach Reunion, da løgnedetektoren tvinger Morgan til at indrømme sandheden, et nyt forhold afsløres og utroskab afdækkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser tager til et vinterlandskab for at se, om de kan finde deres næste udkårne, men de ved ikke, at deres ekser vil komme stormende som en lavine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callum og Nicoles ekser skaber store problemer. En forbindelse bliver skabt og hurtigt brudt igen. En ny eks kommer, og den første hotte date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gør et akavet forsøg på at skabe en forbindelse. Det går hedt for sig i Hemmelighedssaunaen for en lumsk single. Den første eks bliver frosset ude.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Will skal leve med konsekvenserne af at forsøge at holde fast i sit forhold til Courtney, mens han leder efter sit perfekte match. Huset slår sig løs og deler skjulte talenter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One
programme.desc: Efter ugers diskussion med hinanden om, hvordan man finder en match, slår singlerne sig sammen og sætter mere på spil end nogensinde for at finde ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Ti singlepiger og ti singlefyre skal tilbringe en måned sammen mens de finder ud af, hvem som passer sammen. Klarer de det, kan de dele det største præmiebeløb i MTV\s historie - en million dollar.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står over for den ultimative venskabsprøve, da hans bedste ven (Jason Biggs) hyrer ham til at tage hans eks (Kate Hudson) med på en skidt date for at få hende til at indse, hvor god en kæreste han er.

programme.title: Plus One
programme.desc: For at overleve sommerens mange bryllupper aftaler de mangeårige venner, singlerne Ben og Alice, at være hinandens ledsagere til alle de bryllupper, de er inviteret til. Filmen vandt publikumsprisen på Tribeca Film Festival.

programme.title: A Nice Girl Like You
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet anklaget for at være for snerpet af sin ekskæreste skriver Lucy, en ellers genert violinist, en temmelig vild to do-liste, som sender hende hovedkulds ud i en selvopdagelsesrejse. Baseret på Ayn Carrillo-Gaileys populære erindringsbog

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby: Part 1
programme.desc: Rosemary (Zoe Saldana) og Guy (Patrick J. Adams) starter et nyt liv i Paris, hvor en god gerning fører til venskab med et rigt og magtfuldt par, der måske skjuler en mørk hemmelighed.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby: Part 2
programme.desc: Rosemary (Zoe Saldana), der er plaget af angst og sygdom, nærer I stigende grad mistanke om, at hendes mand og naboer har bagtanker om hendes ufødte søn.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende historie om basketballtræner Ken Carter, som både fik ros og kritik, da han skabte overskrifter ved at sætte hele sit ubesejrede hold på bænken som resultat af en ringe, akademisk præstation.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas - Til Jackpot Os Skiller
programme.desc: Jack (Ashton Kutcher) og Joy (Cameron Diaz) vågner op og opdager, at de er blevet gift! I stedet for annullering idømmes de ½ års ægteskab, da Jack vinder 3 mio. med Joys penge. De vil gøre alt for at snyde hinanden, men kærlighed vinder mod alle odds.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: En kvinde og en forfatter udforsker identitet og kærlighed i Toscana. Romantik med Juliette Binoche.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: David Rice er en Jumper, dvs. født med evnen til at teleportere sig hen, hvor han vil. Han opdager, at andre har samme evne, og bliver pludselig jagtet af fanatikere, der har svoret at eliminere alle Jumpere. Måske er denne evne nu hans eneste chance.

programme.title: Jackass 2.5
programme.desc: Jackass 2.5 er præcis lige så utilregnelig, vanvittig og bizar som de foregående film - endda i en sådan grad, at den aldrig ville kunne vises i biograferne.

programme.title: Jackass 3.5
programme.desc: Drengene fra Jackass er i gang igen med endnu flere vild stunt og ravage. Få desuden et indblik i det paranoide liv på Jackass-settet.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Da en opdagelsesrejsendes søgen efter en diamantmine ender tragisk i Congo, sender hans far og ekpeditiones CEO Dr. Karen Roos ud i junglen for at fortsætte jagten... Måske på hans søn, men helt sikkert på diamanterne.

programme.title: Nick Of Time
programme.desc: Gene kommer hjem efter at have deltaget i sin ekskones begravelse. Snart efter bliver hans datter bortført. Han får en pistol og får at vide, at hans datter bliver dræbt, hvis han ikke har slået en vis person ihjel inden for en time og et kvarter.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Det store slag har sin begyndelse da helten Leonidas – kun bevæbnet med læderundertøj og en kappe – førersin gruppe af 13(!) krigere mod nord for at forsvare hjemlandet mod…

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens (Nat Wolff) er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons (Selena Gomez) hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangsters søn.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singlekvinde med fokus på karrieren i New York bliver tvunget til at forholde sig til følgerne af et forlist forhold, da hendes ekskæreste hyrer hendes firma. En moderne udgave af Jane Austens roman ”Kærlighed og svaghed”.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush er baseret på Bill Keenans komiske erindringer af samme navn. Den amerikanske ishockeyspiller Bobby Sanders fra Harvard’s hockeyteam bliver byttet til en svensk 1. div. klub for en vaske-tørremaskine.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Diane er en snerpet advokat fra New York, der netop er blevet vraget af sin mand. I et desperat forsøg på at glemme alt om skilsmissen, tager hun sammen med sine to teenagebørn på en impulsiv weekendtur. Destinationen er en økologisk gård nær Woodstock.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalist Tama Drewe vender tilbage til sine rødder i en engelsk landsby, for at sælge sit barndomshjem efter sin mors død. Stort drama, på grænsen til tumult, udspiller sig, når nya og gamle bekendtskaber går på jagt efter den ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: Evil Twins: Gann Twins
programme.desc: Identical twins Jordan and Simon Gann had potential in their youth. But as teens they take an inexplicable dark turn launching a global crime spree.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Mind Investigators: Under Pressure
programme.desc: In the fall of 2013, a 23 years old man, volunteer in the army, is arrested for killing his brother.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: 48 Hours: FindJodi!
programme.desc: A report on new information in the search for Iowa television anchor Jodi Huisentruit, who disappeared on her way to work on June 27, 1995.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Topeka
programme.desc: In 2002 in Topeka, Kansas, newly engaged Michael Sisco and Karen Harkness were brutally shot from the foot of their bed while they slept.

programme.title: On the Case: Tangled Web
programme.desc: A romantic Valentine's Day rendezvous ends in murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Alternate Suspects
programme.desc: A football coach serves nine years in prison for the murder of his wife before a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals finds he didn't get a fair trial.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Milford, Utah is a tough town where possession is nine-tenths of the law and a gun makes up the rest. That's why handyman Tony Hamilton didn't take too kindly to the county seizing the Mormon ranch where he lived for back taxes.

programme.title: COPS: My Bills Won't Wait
programme.desc: A suspect calls the police and states that he wants to kill himself and any officer who tries to help him. None of the three occupants of a stopped car will admit to ownership of a bag of drugs.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The sad story of Mel Fisher, the chicken farmer who became a celebrated treasure hunter before he ran afoul of the law.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: The Luchalooters
programme.desc: Celebrity little people and twin wrestlers Jorge and Miguel have a larger-than-life appetite for drugs and alcohol. And when they're both found dead after a wild night of partying, an autopsy reveals the culprit is eye drops.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Evil Empire
programme.desc: The Manson Family are responsible for terrifying Hollywood after a series of brutal murders that targeted celebrities, including pregnant actress Sharon Tate.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Unusual Australian Shark Arm Murder
programme.desc: Follow along as hosts Ryan and Shane go down under to examine a shark, a speedboat, and a mysterious severed arm.
programme.sub-title: The Unusual Australian Shark Arm Murder

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: Comedy Central Stand-Up Presents Julio Torres
programme.desc: Julio Torres discusses veganism and the vulnerability of Daisy Duck and reads some entries from Melania Trump's diary.

programme.title: South Park: Døde børn
programme.desc: Randy forsøger desperat at hjælpe Sharon med at kontrollere sine følelser, og Cartman dumper i matematik.

programme.title: Workaholics: Karl's Wedding
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake holder deres ven Karls bryllup i deres baghave. Karl skal giftes med pigen, han elsker, men elsker hun ham? Blake ved noget, som Karl ikke ved, men han er bange for at ødelægge Karls store dag.

programme.title: South Park: Den magiske busk
programme.desc: Cartman og Butters får fat i en drone og tager på en flyvetur rundt i kvarteret.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi-special
programme.desc: Randy må erkende sin rolle i covid-19-udbruddet, da pandemien fortsætter med at skabe problemer i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tandfe-tingeltangel 2000
programme.desc: Cartman får 2 dollar af tandfeen, så drengene trækker så mange tænder som muligt ud i håb om at kunne købe et nyt videospillesystem.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.title: Workaholics: Gayborhood
programme.desc: En vild nat i en nabos hus får fyrene til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved deres forhold.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Da drengene rejser til Aspen for at stå på ski for første gang, lægger Stan sig ud med en af de lokale og bliver udfordret til et løb.

programme.title: South Park: Overlogging
programme.desc: Der opstår forvirring og panik, da South Park opdager, at internettet er forsvundet!

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Tilbageblik
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbage og denne gang har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Broadway bro-down
programme.desc: Da Randy lærer hemmeligheden bag musicals at kende kan han ikke lade være med at tage Sharon med til at se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber og Elton John advarer ham om ikke at afsløre deres hemmelighed.

programme.title: South Park: Korrekt kondombrug
programme.desc: Takket være Stans 'håndarbejde' må børnene i South Park udholde sexundervisning fra den usandsynlige duo Mr. Mackey og Ms. Choksondik.

programme.title: South Park: Omvendt cowgirl
programme.desc: Clyde glemmer at slå toiletbrættet ned, med tragiske konsekvenser: Hans mor dør! Tragedien resulterer i ny lovgivning for toiletbrug. Stan overbeviser Clyde om, at han skal sagsøge opfinderen af toilettet.

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Drengene tilmelder Butters som gæst i et populært talkshow, hvor folk med deformiteter medvirker.

programme.title: South Park: Tøsen
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman er Wendy Testaburger blevet lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Bætyve
programme.desc: Kyles mor får en fækal transplantation, og drengene er på jagt efter den bedste mikrobiom.

programme.title: South Park: Skøgejagt
programme.desc: Det lykkes Kyles far at skjule, at han er en internettrold samtidig med, at han spreder sine grovheder globalt.

programme.title: South Park: Spis, bed, queef
programme.desc: Mændene i South Park er frastødt af den nye kvindedille 'queefing' og prøver at få den forbudt.

programme.title: South Park: Femlinger 2000
programme.desc: Medierne viser en overvældende interesse for en familie med femlinger, som flytter til South Park, og Catman bliver gode venner med en af dem. Kennys mor forsøger at tjene penge ved at planlægge sin egen fødsel af flere børn.

programme.title: South Park: Åh, nej
programme.desc: Gerald står ansigt til ansigt med Troll-jægeren.

programme.title: South Park: Kodage
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park er overbeviste om, at et par, der har vundet en ferie i South Park, har stjålet deres mindesmærke 'Cow Days'. Faktisk er det køerne, der har flyttet den.

programme.title: South Park: T.M.I.
programme.desc: Efter en pinlig situation, der involverer visse kropsdele, bliver Cartman send til et kursus i vredeskontrol og Randy gør hvad han kan for at tage sig af efterdønningerne.

programme.title: South Park: Det fattige barn
programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Stan får en Okama Gamesphere, og drengene er fascinerede af den. Mens de spiller, kommer et talende håndklæde ved navn Towelie og taler med dem.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbitten
programme.desc: Wendy forsøger at føre en af sine veninder sammen med Butters, men ender på skolevejlederens kontor.

programme.title: South Park: Fede røv og pandekagehoved
programme.desc: Cartman laver en J-lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement for kulturel mangfoldighed, der hylder latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Efter at have undladt at læse det med småt i sin kontrakt bliver Kyle kidnappet af Apple,der har store planer for ham. Det er op til drengene at redde ham.

programme.title: South Park: Crème Fraiche
programme.desc: Irriteret over Randys perverse besættelse af madlavningsprogrammer, søger Stan Gordon Ramseys hjælp. Jamie Oliver er ikke lige så hjælpsom.

programme.title: South Park: SUPER HÅRD politisk korrekthed
programme.desc: Det har aldrig været mere udfordrende at være en PK-rektor.

programme.title: South Park: Utroligt og modigt
programme.desc: Drenge viser Caitlyn Jenner deres enorme respekt i det mest fantastiske og modige 'South Park'-afsnit nogensinde.

programme.title: South Park: Fedelejr
programme.desc: Mrs. Cartman vil gøre noget for afhjælpe sin søns spiseproblem og sender ham på en lejr for fede børn.

programme.title: South Park: Sikkert (del 2)
programme.desc: I en krise beder Satan Gud om råd, og Cartman afsløres som en bedrager. Som straf bliver han sendt til Mexico.

programme.title: South Park: Grundskolemusical
programme.desc: Da musical-galskaben, hvor alle skal danse og synge, rammer South Park, må drengene gå med på den eller opgive deres popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Angående i aftes
programme.desc: En ny præsident er blevet valgt og beboerne i South Park fejrer det i gaderne. Mens hele landet fester, overrasker den nye præsidenten alle da han ankommer til Det Hvide Hus alt for tidllig.

programme.title: South Park: Supersjov
programme.desc: South Park Elementary har sendt Mr. Garrisons klasse på skoleudflugt til Pioneer Village, en historisk by hvor alle de ansatte lader som om det er 1864.

programme.title: South Park: Seksuel healing
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinder sig midt blandt Amerikas superkendisser, når de bliver behandlet for sexafhængighed. Cartman og Stan er klistret til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle er klar til det store gennembrud med deres evner på computerspillet Guitar Hero. Deres manager overbeviser Stan om, at Kyle holder ham tilbage, hvilket skaber spændinger.

programme.title: South Park: Fjerde klasse
programme.desc: Ungerne bliver nødt til at starte i 4. klasse, og det er de ikke alt for glade for.

programme.title: South Park: Medicinsk stegt kylling
programme.desc: Cartman bliver rasende, når han finder ud af, at hans yndlingsrestaurant er lavet om til en medicinsk marihuana-udlevering. Randy er ikke lige så skuffet.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiske påskespecial
programme.desc: Stan prøver at finde ud af grunden til malede påskeæg og opdager en hemmelighed om den katolske kirke.

programme.title: South Park: Toms plastikoperation
programme.desc: Drengene prøver at blive lesbiske for at gøre indtryk på en lærer.I mellemtiden får Mr. Garrisons plastikkirurgi ham, til hans store fornøjelse, til at ligne David Hasselhoff.

programme.title: South Park: Mandelproblemer
programme.desc: En sjusket blodtransfusion resulterer i, at Cartmann får AIDS. Hvor langt vil han gå for at blive kureret?

programme.title: South Park: Byens kerne
programme.desc: South Parks bykerne skal opgraderes og Kenny bestemmer sig for, at det er på tide at finde et job.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys juleklassikere
programme.desc: Denne special-episode giver nogle numre fra Mr. Hankeys julealbum.
